> [!WARNING]
> **BETA / TEST BUILD — NOT FINISHED.**
>
> This is an early build for testing only. It has not been validated against live Steam trades, and the ASF 7 support depends on a pre-release ASF version. Do not use it on a bot that holds items you cannot afford to lose. The ASF 6 asset is the more tested one.

### Compatibility

| ArchiSteamFarm | Plugin asset | Target framework |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ASF 6.3.11.7 (latest stable) | `TradeManagerPlus.zip` | `net10.0` |
| ASF 7.0.0.7 (pre-release) | `TradeManagerPlus-V7.zip` | `net11.0` |

ASF 7 is still a pre-release and requires the .NET 11 SDK/runtime. Support for it may change before ASF 7 goes stable. ASF 6 remains supported.

This release is marked as a pre-release and is not offered through the ASF automatic update channel.

### Changelog

This is automated GitHub deployment, human-readable changelog should be available soon.
